# apple_ci_xcode_versions (Data Source)

Lists available Xcode Cloud records, following all pages. Set up Xcode Cloud and its SCM connection in Xcode/App Store Connect first. IDs can be passed to `apple_ci_workflow`; Apple validates Xcode/macOS compatibility when writing the workflow.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_ci_xcode_versions" "all" {}

output "versions" {
  value = data.apple_ci_xcode_versions.all.versions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `versions` (Attributes List) Available records in Apple's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Apple record ID.
- `name` (String) Version display name.
- `test_destinations` (Attributes List) Supported test devices and runtimes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions--test_destinations))
- `version` (String) Version number.

<a id="nestedatt--versions--test_destinations"></a>

Read-Only:

- `device_type_identifier` (String) Device type identifier.
- `device_type_name` (String) Device display name.
- `kind` (String) `SIMULATOR` or `MAC`.
